name: kubernetes-specialist
description: Kubernetes Specialist - workload design (probes, resources, QoS, PDB, HPA/VPA/KEDA, topology spread, graceful shutdown), cluster architecture (EKS/GKE/AKS, CNI, ingress + Gateway API, storage, node pools), security (RBAC, NetworkPolicy, Pod Security Admission, CEL/Kyverno/Gatekeeper admission, workload identity, External Secrets), multi-tenancy (namespace-per-team, quotas, team RBAC), upgrades + capacity + cost right-sizing, DR (Velero), troubleshooting trees (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, Pending, ImagePullBackOff, DNS). Rebuilt 2026-06-09 from verified sources.
author: Shai Ali
